paths.name: react
paths.message: These hooks ship in React 19 but the runtime is React 18.3. They will be `undefined` at runtime and crash the component. Use `useFormState` from `react-dom` instead of `useActionState`. `useOptimistic` has no React-18 equivalent — model the optimistic state manually with `useState`.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Don't merge .skip()'d tests. Either fix it, delete it, or convert to test.todo('reason — issue link') with a tracking issue. R11-I gate.
